product_overview: SUB INFRA is an internal web application for centralizing and managing administrative processes related to payments and infrastructure, providing dashboards and CRUD tools for process tracking and reporting.
core_goals: Monitor and visualize process statuses and locations in real time via an analytic dashboard
Enable efficient search, creation, editing and historical tracking of processes
Provide exports (PDF/Excel) and printable reports for operational and managerial use
Ensure data integrity and role-based access via Supabase authentication

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Provides visual metrics and quick filters: counters, doughnut chart for statuses, bar chart for locations, and dashboard cards that act as quick filters for the main table.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See total processes counter and status counters -> View doughnut chart of process statuses -> View bar chart of process locations -> Click a segment on the doughnut chart -> See main table filtered by the clicked status

Navigate to / -> See dashboard cards with counters -> Click 'Em Tramitação' card -> See main table filtered to 'Em Tramitação' processes -> Click a table row -> Open "Editar Processo" modal -> See process details in modal
Navigate to / -> Attempt to load doughnut chart of process statuses -> See chart load error or empty state message -> See notification suggesting retry or check connection

features.name: Process Management
features.description: Full CRUD for administrative processes with search, filters by status/location, modals for creating/editing, timeline history per process, and export to PDF/Excel.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click search input -> Type process number '12345' -> Press Enter -> See search results list with matching processes -> Click a process row -> Click 'Editar Processo' button -> Edit 'Fornecedor' field -> Click Save -> See success notification -> See updated process in table
Navigate to / -> Click search input -> Type non-existent process number '00000' -> Press Enter -> See 'No processes found' message

Navigate to / -> Click 'Novo Processo' button -> Fill 'Fornecedor' field -> Fill 'Objeto' field -> Fill 'Valor da Capa' field -> Fill 'Data de Abertura' field -> Fill 'Prazo' field -> Click Submit -> See success notification -> See new process in table
Navigate to / -> Click 'Novo Processo' button -> Leave 'Fornecedor' field empty -> Fill other required fields -> Click Submit -> See validation error indicating 'Fornecedor' is required

Navigate to / -> Apply Filter by Status and Location -> See filtered processes in main table -> Click a process row -> Click 'Histórico de Processo' button -> View 'Histórico de Processo' modal -> See timeline entries listed by date
Navigate to / -> Click a process row -> Click 'Histórico de Processo' button -> View 'Histórico de Processo' modal -> See 'No history entries' message or history load error
Navigate to / -> Apply desired filters -> Click Export PDF button -> Wait for PDF to generate -> Receive downloaded PDF file with filtered processes
Navigate to / -> Apply desired filters -> Click Export Excel button -> Wait for export -> Receive downloaded Excel file with filtered processes
Navigate to / -> Click Export PDF button -> Export service fails or network error occurs -> See export error notification and no file downloaded
